correctness.rationale: For strictly interior environments, differentiation of logistic odds gives u1*l1_dot=x-u1, u2*l2_dot=y-u2, 2*u12*l12_dot=x+y-2*u12, hence H_dot=2*u12-u1-u2. Logistic preservation keeps H defined globally at each finite time. The positive-weight maximum inequality gives the exact signed logistic boundary envelope; equality is attained at all environmental triples whose signed logits are equal. Unbounded affine H excludes compact interior recurrent or invariant states and invariant measures. Explicit admissible games and exact resonance yield a continuum of fully interior equilibria. The standalone checker passed 180 exact rational cancellations, 250 envelope/attainment cases, a five-variable 30-time-unit integration with maximum drift residual 3.05e-11, and an asymmetric equilibrium test with exactly zero residual.

value.rationale: The result supplies a payoff-independent global exclusion of every compact interior recurrent regime in a nonlinear five-dimensional multi-community game, complementing source numerical anti-synchrony and multistability. It locates an exact codimension-one harmonic compatibility surface, provides a pointwise optimal logistic envelope, an explicit exponential approach rate and a finite uninterrupted residence-time bound, and proves attainability via an asymmetric one-dimensional interior equilibrium family in fixed admissible games. It does not confuse convergence to a boundary union with convergence to one face, and does not claim arbitrary-game sufficiency.
